mapper.sql: id, code, name, category, risk_level, expected_return, term_days, min_amount, total_amount, sold_amount, manager, description, status, created_at, updated_at

where.if: AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_product WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY expected_return DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_product (code, name, category, risk_level, expected_return, term_days, min_amount, total_amount, sold_amount, manager, description, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{category}, #{riskLevel}, #{expectedReturn}, #{termDays}, #{minAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{soldAmount}, #{manager}, #{description}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_product SET code = #{code}, name = #{name}, category = #{category}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}, expected_return = #{expectedReturn}, term_days = #{termDays}, min_amount = #{minAmount}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, manager = #{manager}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_product SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_product SET sold_amount = sold_amount + #{amount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND sold_amount + #{amount} <= total_amount
